HISD Button

The primary call-to-action surface, in four intent variants — action, secondary, ghost, and danger — shown across every state in both the light and dark themes. All colors derive from semantic tokens; the component carries no hard-coded values.

Light theme data-theme="light"

Action — default · hover · active · focus

Secondary

Ghost

Danger — destructive only

Disabled

Loading — aria-busy, label swapped for spinner

Leading icon · icon-only (aria-label)

Dark theme data-theme="dark"

Action — default · hover · active · focus

Secondary

Ghost

Danger — destructive only

Disabled

Loading — aria-busy, label swapped for spinner

Leading icon · icon-only (aria-label)

Copy-paste snippet

<!-- Load tokens first, then the component styles -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="hisd-theme.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="button.css">

<!-- Action (filled): the single dominant action per view -->
<button type="button" class="hisd-button hisd-button--action">
  <span class="hisd-button__label">Save changes</span>
</button>

<!-- Secondary (outlined) -->
<button type="button" class="hisd-button hisd-button--secondary">
  <span class="hisd-button__label">Cancel</span>
</button>

<!-- Ghost (text) -->
<button type="button" class="hisd-button hisd-button--ghost">
  <span class="hisd-button__label">Learn more</span>
</button>

<!-- Danger (filled): destructive, irreversible actions only -->
<button type="button" class="hisd-button hisd-button--danger">
  <span class="hisd-button__label">Delete</span>
</button>

<!-- Loading: add aria-busy="true"; spinner replaces the label -->
<button type="button" class="hisd-button hisd-button--action" aria-busy="true">
  <span class="hisd-button__spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span>
  <span class="hisd-button__label">Submit</span>
</button>

<!-- Disabled: native attribute -->
<button type="button" class="hisd-button hisd-button--action" disabled>
  <span class="hisd-button__label">Save changes</span>
</button>

<!-- Icon-only: aria-label is REQUIRED -->
<button type="button" class="hisd-button hisd-button--secondary hisd-button--icon-only"
        aria-label="Add item">
  <span class="hisd-button__icon" aria-hidden="true">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"
         stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>
  </span>
</button>
